content.user_title: Build Compliant HR Workflows and Templates
content.value_statement: HR teams need consistent, practical materials across the employee lifecycle. This skill creates structured drafts, checklists, communications, and implementation plans with compliance guardrails.
actual_capabilities: Draft job descriptions with outcomes, competencies, requirements, pay details, and inclusive language.
Create structured interview questions, scoring rubrics, panel plans, scorecards, and debrief checklists.
Build onboarding plans, access checklists, first-week schedules, buddy programs, and feedback milestones.
Prepare PTO and leave policy drafts with eligibility, accrual, approvals, carryover, and coverage rules.
Produce competency matrices, goals, review packets, calibration guidance, and performance improvement plan templates.
Outline employee relations intake, investigation, documentation, conflict resolution, and offboarding materials.
limitations: The skill provides general HR information and templates, not legal advice.
Jurisdiction, workforce structure, and company policies are required for relevant drafts.
The skill cannot confirm current laws, collective agreements, or counsel-approved language.
The skill does not operate HR systems, store employee records, or make employment decisions.

use_cases.title: Standardize Hiring
use_cases.description: Create a job description, interview kit, rubric, panel plan, and candidate communications for one role.

use_cases.title: Launch Employee Programs
use_cases.description: Prepare onboarding, leave, performance, or offboarding materials with owners, timelines, communications, and metrics.

use_cases.title: Handle Workplace Issues
use_cases.description: Draft neutral intake, investigation, documentation, and resolution frameworks with privacy and escalation safeguards.
use_cases.target_user: People managers and employee relations specialists

prompt_templates.title: Create an HR Checklist
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a checklist for {{HRProcess}} at {{CompanyName}}. Include owners, timing, required inputs, communication steps, and completion criteria.
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner request for a practical workflow

prompt_templates.title: Build an Interview Kit
prompt_templates.prompt: Build a structured interview kit for {{RoleTitle}} in {{Jurisdiction}}. Include competencies, questions, scoring anchors, panel assignments, and a debrief process.

prompt_templates.title: Draft a Workplace Policy
prompt_templates.prompt: Draft a {{PolicyType}} policy for {{CompanyProfile}} in {{Jurisdiction}}. State assumptions, eligibility, procedures, responsibilities, exceptions, communications, metrics, and legal review points.

prompt_templates.title: Design a Multi-Country HR Program
prompt_templates.prompt: Design a {{ProgramName}} framework for teams in {{Jurisdictions}}. Separate global standards from local requirements, risks, counsel questions, rollout steps, and governance metrics.

output_examples.input: Create an interview kit for a remote customer support manager in California.
output_examples.output: A Markdown package containing role outcomes, competencies, ten interview questions, five-point scoring anchors, panel assignments, a scorecard, and a compliant debrief checklist.

output_examples.input: Draft an accrual-based PTO policy for a 50-person company.
output_examples.output: A policy draft covering eligibility, accrual, requests, carryover, coverage, assumptions, implementation owners, employee communication, measurement, and items requiring local legal review.

output_examples.input: Prepare a 30-day performance improvement plan for a sales representative.
output_examples.output: A coaching-focused plan with objective expectations, evidence sources, support commitments, check-in dates, documentation standards, possible outcomes, and legal escalation notes.

best_practices: Provide jurisdiction, company size, employment types, union status, and internal policy constraints.
Replace placeholders and verify every draft against current law, contracts, and approved company practices.
Use job-related criteria, consistent scoring, factual documentation, and the minimum necessary personal data.
anti_patterns: Do not use generated materials as final legal advice or skip qualified local counsel.
Do not provide protected medical details, unnecessary personal data, or unsupported allegations.
Do not use subjective hiring criteria, discriminatory questions, inconsistent discipline, or undocumented employment decisions.

faq.question: Does this skill provide legal advice?
faq.answer: No. It provides general HR guidance and drafts that require review by qualified local counsel.

faq.question: What information should I provide?
faq.answer: Provide the jurisdiction, company profile, workforce types, union status, policy constraints, desired outcome, and timeline.

faq.question: Can it create hiring materials?
faq.answer: Yes. It can draft job descriptions, structured questions, scoring rubrics, panel plans, scorecards, and candidate communications.

faq.question: Can it support international teams?
faq.answer: Yes, but it separates global principles from local checks and recommends counsel in every relevant jurisdiction.

faq.question: How does it handle sensitive employee data?
faq.answer: It recommends data minimization and asks users to avoid unnecessary medical, protected-class, or personally identifiable information.

faq.question: What format does it produce?
faq.answer: It produces a Markdown package with summary, assumptions, final artifacts, implementation steps, communications, metrics, and legal notes.
